main_characteristics: High yielding boro rice variety.Plant height around 103 cm and crop duration is around 150 days. Flag leaf broad, erect and dark green. The grain is white in colour, slender and 1000 grain weight is 22.7 gram. Rice contains 28% amylose and 7.5% protein.
source_org: BRRI, via BSMRAU Digital Herbarium of Crop Plants
